title: Green Top broccoli (Green Top F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Green Top broccoli is an F1 hybrid broccoli variety from Allied Botanical. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Green Top broccoli is an F1 hybrid broccoli variety, also sold or known as Green Top F1. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical.

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Green Top broccoli is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Green Top F1, this is the same broccoli. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [broccoli variety finder](/crop-varieties/broccoli), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).
Key facts about Green Top broccoli

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources
rows: Days to harvest, per the seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit broccoli fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** 50 to 55 days after transplanting.
**Fruit:** Head: large, compact, half dome, small beads, 450 to 500 g.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: allied Botanical's early broccoli for lowland farms in the dry season, the only evidence found is Allied's listing. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual broccoli on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Green Top broccoli
Broccoli is a cool weather crop for the highlands. Pick a variety with a tight, even head. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is Green Top F1 the same as Green Top?
items.a: Yes. Green Top F1 is another name for Green Top. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Green Top?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
